episodes.title: The Angamaly Shift
episodes.break_rationale: Concludes as Ashley attends her first Bethlehem Kudumba Unit prayer gathering in Angamaly, where her unexpected musical connection with Justin first ignites neighborhood curiosity.
episodes.recap_text: Following financial distress in Mundakkayam, Ashley and her family relocate to Angamaly. While adjusting to the unfamiliar neighborhood, she crosses paths with Justin, the charismatic church choir and music coordinator.
episodes.teaser_next: Secret late-night choir rehearsals and impromptu scooter rides spark suspicions among the watchful Kudumba Unit elders.

episodes.title: Rhythms & Rumors
episodes.break_rationale: Justin confesses his genuine feelings to Ashley on the eve of the parish feast, just as neighborhood gossip threatens to expose their secret romance to her conservative family.
episodes.recap_text: Bonding over their shared love for music, Ashley and Justin's secret romance blossoms despite their contrasting backgrounds, navigating humorous neighbor encounters and community choir practice.
episodes.teaser_next: An unexpected letter of admission and student visa for Ireland arrives, threatening to tear Ashley and Justin apart.

episodes.title: The Ireland Dilemma
episodes.break_rationale: Emotional airport departure as Justin selflessly encourages Ashley to board her flight to Dublin, cutting forward eighteen months to her sudden return to Angamaly.
episodes.recap_text: Faced with her family's hopes and an overseas education in Ireland, Ashley is torn between her future and her love for Justin. Justin makes the agonizing choice to let her go.
episodes.teaser_next: Ashley returns to Kerala for a neighbor's wedding, only to discover Justin standing across the parish church courtyard.

episodes.title: Harmonies of Bethlehem
episodes.break_rationale: The miniseries concludes with the joyful choir performance at the parish wedding, bringing Ashley and Justin's heartfelt love story to a triumphant, heartwarming close.
episodes.recap_text: Eighteen months after leaving for Ireland, Ashley returns to Angamaly and confronts the feelings she left behind, leading to a tender and hilarious reunion with Justin.
episodes.teaser_next: Series finale concludes the heartwarming Malayalam romantic comedy-drama miniseries.
